text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"The day of the JBC Classic. Her 'First 
Place in Every Race' declaration reaches 
its halfway mark with race number three."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ever since making her declaration, Smart 
Falcon had consistently aimed for victory 
with a cool head. But today, she seemed 
distracted and lacked focus.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer asks to talk after the race, 
but she cuts the conversation short with a 
smile and heads straight onto the track.
